rules.name: Verified problem identity
rules.reason: Full user supplied statement cross-checked against retrieved organizer catalogue on 9 September 2026. Initial SIH2171 shorthand superseded.

rules.name: Six-person delivery ceiling
rules.reason: Architecture and scope docs record one primary journey, ≤2 services (browser client + Node server), ≤1 SQLite audit store, ≤1 optional local Ollama provider. No custom training or specialized hardware required for the candidate. Evidence: Docs/architecture.md, Docs/scope.md.

rules.name: Reproducible complete workflow
rules.reason: Wave5 e2e harness writes Benchmarks/results/e2e.json maximizing inject/collect, activeTab gate, overlay UI protect loop, and demo screenshots. Toolbar glyph automation, Firefox live, and full multi-scenario clean-setup persistence remain open — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Evidence-backed differentiation
rules.reason: Wiki/competitors.md compares ≥5 adjacent solutions. Implemented differentiator (pixel-free egress + selective local preview + expiring references) demonstrated against full-image mask baseline via held-out fixtures and extension sanitize evidence. No first/unique global claims. Evidence: Benchmarks/results/differentiation.json.

rules.name: Prototype capacity floor
rules.reason: Wave6 load.json: 20 concurrent health workers (1000 ok), 1000 durable audit rows, 1000 API writes under simulated rate windows. Wall-clock seconds, not 5-minute soak — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Validated requests and safe output
rules.reason: Server Zod schema validation, auth/origin allowlist, body size and rate limits covered by Prototype unit tests; client assertSanitizedPayload + capture-loop forbid screenshot/pixel/URL fields before network; Wave3 security.json records 0 high secret-scan findings and cites harness sanitize evidence. Malformed payloads return controlled errors in unit coverage. Scope: local prototype, not multi-tenant production.

rules.name: Access and data boundaries
rules.reason: Public demo and fixtures are explicitly synthetic; audit SQLite stores counts/timings only (no screen/prompt/token); .env and Prototype/data/ gitignored; Wave3 security scan found 0 high-severity secrets in tracked sources; pairing token is local session/file mode 0600 and not committed. Cross-user multi-tenant auth is out of current single-operator local scope.

rules.name: Deployment controls
rules.reason: Wave6 hardening.json proves headers, origin allowlist, Bearer auth, 256KiB body limit, rate limit 429+Retry-After, error hygiene, screenshot-field reject. Pages static HTTPS; Node loopback default with HTTPS PUBLIC_ORIGIN gate beyond 127.0.0.1; production debug off for API errors. security.json + dependency-audit.json: 0 high secrets, 0 critical/high npm omit=dev. Scope: local prototype deployment controls — not multi-tenant production TLS reverse-proxy verification.

rules.name: WCAG 2.1 AA review
rules.reason: Wave6 accessibility.json axe: Website + extension popup + prototype pages 0 violations (after contrast fix + reveal-ready visibility). Docs/accessibility-review.md updated. Full WCAG criterion-level + AT review incomplete — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Responsive and motion safety
rules.reason: browser-review.json Wave6 adds CSS zoom 200% approximation for Website + popup. Native 200% zoom / complete motion-safety incomplete — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Core response time
rules.reason: core-latency.json (Wave6) keeps planner-inclusive full-flow fail vs 200ms. Judge_latency_breakdown adds stage p95 + mosaic subsample optimization. Budget not weakened.

rules.name: Website Lighthouse quality
rules.reason: Six fresh local Lighthouse 12.8.2 runs after the video addition: mobile performance 99, desktop performance 100, and all accessibility/best-practices/SEO scores 100. Automated site scores only; not WCAG conformance or prototype performance.

rules.name: Error recovery
rules.reason: Frozen fault scenarios recover with usable next steps: activeTab denial, content-script reinject, restricted pages, sanitize reject, expired reference, user cancel, provider unavailable / privacy-only fallback. Evidence: Benchmarks/results/recovery.json.

rules.name: Live and recorded fallback
rules.reason: Docs/demo-rehearsal-checklist.md + demo-fallback.webm + demo-rehearsal.json exist. 3 consecutive live rehearsals from reset not logged — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Honest impact and capability
rules.reason: Docs/claim-ledger.json lists empirical claims with source, type and limits; fabricated metrics forbidden. Official score null; G11 fail retained; WebPII failure published.

rules.name: Measurable social impact framework
rules.reason: Docs/impact-model.md defines outcome specification, pilot design, cost ledger and environmental account with null parameters until sourced. No projected results reported as observed outcomes.

rules.name: Submission format and narrative
rules.reason: Docs/template-audit.md verifies six-slide supplied structure; Docs/submission-deck.pptx and Docs/presentation-render/ exist; longer pitch deck is separate. SIH26171 identity and honesty caveats visible. Evidence: Docs/template-audit.md, Docs/submission-deck.pptx, Docs/presentation-render/.

rules.name: Deployable and maintainable handoff
rules.reason: Prototype/README.md covers install, config, run, test, build, extension load, backup/restore, deploy notes and known limits. Docs/deployment-verification.md records Pages verification. No unconfigured contact implies a live Node API.

rules.name: Attribution and channel integrity
rules.reason: Raw/sources.json and Wiki/source-index.md retain attribution; failed private channels recorded as inaccessible in reference intake. Competitor and problem citations mapped in Wiki.

rules.name: Real human validation
rules.reason: Docs/human-evaluation-protocol.md + Docs/human-evaluation-forms.md + human-evaluation.json publish templates with zero non-author participants — status stays unknown.

limitations: This aggregator checks recorded review states and evidence presence; it does not execute or authenticate all tests.
Website-only measurements do not validate the domain prototype.
